description: This file defines the TaskService class which implements the ITaskService interface; it contains business logic related to task management, including CRUD operations and internal mapping methods.

classes.name: TaskService
classes.description: Provides business logic for task operations such as creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting tasks.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves all tasks and maps them to DTOs.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a task by its ID and maps it to a DTO if found.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new task entity from provided DTO, saves it, and returns its DTO.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing task entity identified by ID with new data from DTO.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a task entity identified by ID.

methods.name: MapToDto
methods.description: Converts a TaskItem entity into a TaskDto object.
